violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates
violation_type.typical_finding: There were four classrooms being used during inspection.  In the infant classroom, the activity plan did not have the date.  In a second classroom, the activity plan was not for the current week.

finding_variants.text: There were four classrooms being used during inspection.  In the infant classroom, the activity plan did not have the date.  In a second classroom, the activity plan was not for the current week.
The written activity plans posted in three of four classrooms were observed to be outdated.  Compliance was met when new activity plans were posted and dated during the inspection.

The activity plan posted in the pre-k room was not current. The date on the activity plan was for the week of 5/11-15/2026.    Note:This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the current activity plan was posted.
The toddler and infant room lacked a written activity plan.
Observed lesson plans in each room without a date. This was corrected when dates were placed on the lesson plans.

The activity plan in a classroom was not dated and another classroom did not have the activity plan posted.     Corrected at Inspection: The activity was dated, and the other activity plan was posted.
